༄༅/ /rje maṅga la'i mtshan can gyi dngul gdung rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten gyi dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje maṅga la'i mtshan can gyi dngul gdung rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten gyi dkar chag bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ don gnyis ldan pa'i ston pa mchog dang bden gnyis mtshan 'dzin dam pa'i chos// rig grol gnyis ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs dang dpal ldan bla ma yi dam lha// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas rnams la rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal nas// mos ldan dad pa'i bsam pa bskyed phyir lhag bsam dag pas 'di skad do// de yang snyigs dus kyi 'dren mchog dam pa rje btsun maṅga la'i mtshan can grub thob nā ro ta pa'i sprul par grags pa de nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zag pa med pa bstan 'gro'i don du rdzogs pa dang*/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i slad du/ dri ma med pa'i mdo nas bde gshegs chos sku'i mchod rten brgyad gsungs pa bu ston rin chen grub dang brag nag pa dpal ldan legs dbang sogs kyis legs par bkral ba las/ rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten cha tshad sogs 'khrul ba'i dri ma thams cad bral zhing*/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu bzhugs pa 'di nyid kyi nang du bzhugs pa'i rim pa mdo tsam brjod pa la/ spyir rten gyi nang du bzhugs pa'i ring bsrel ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ sku gdung gi ring bsrel dang*/ yung 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel dang*| sku bal gyi ring bsrel dang*/ chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel zhes rnam pa bzhir gsungs pa la/ rten 'di'i nang du dang po sku gdung gi ring bsrel bzhugs pa ni/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi gdung rus sman dang rin po che'i lde gur bgyis pa'i sātstsha byas pa mchod rten brgyad kyi rnam pa khri phrag gcig dang nyis brgya bzhugs/ yung 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel la/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i 'phel gdung dang*/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi 'phel gdung*/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i dbu klad las 'khrungs pa'i ring bsrel/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i 'phel gdung*/

rje rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po'i 'phel gdung*/ rje btsun chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi 'phel gdung rnams bzhugs so// sku bal gyi ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i tshul la/ thog mar thub pa'i bstan pa bshad sgrub rnam pa gnyis las/ bshad brgyud dam pa mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi snying por gyur pa don brgyud 'bri gung pa chen po zhes chos ltar bcos pa rnams kyi bsre lhad dang bral zhing*/ mi bar khyis ma chod pa grub thob brgyad cu mu tig star la brgyud pa ltar byon pa/ khyad par bcu gsum bar du ma bsgom par sangs rgyas kho nar 'byon pa grub dbang padma 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan pa 'di nyid kyi gdan sa dang gdung rabs rnams kyi dad rten bzhugs tshul ni/ grub chen tilli pa'i phyag mdzub dang bzhugs gdan kriṣṇa'i lpags pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i dbu lo dang bzhugs gdan snyan rgyan phyag ḍār gyi 'phan mkha' 'gro ma stong gi dbu skra las byas pa/ rje btsun mar pa lo tsā'i dbu lo/ yum bdag med kyi dbu lo/ rje mar mi yab sras thun mong gi zhal skyog /mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i dbu lo dang phya'u rigs gnyis/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i phyag phreng dang dbu zhwa chab bzed dum bu gsol phor gzims gdan phya'u rigs gnyis/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i sha 'gag dang zhabs rjes kyi rdo/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi bzhugs gdan dang phya'u/ khu dbon gsum gyi gdung 'ga' dkar dmar/ gcung rdo rje grags pa'i tshems/ nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal po'i dbu zhwa dang phyag phreng bzhugs gdan/ nyer gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu lo dang chab ser gdung rus/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i gdung rus/ chos rje bco lnga pa'i dbu lo/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po'i gdung rus| rin chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang po'i sku mtshal/ rje kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang po'i phya'u/

rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu lo dang sku sbyar phyag phreng sku chos sku sha ril bu gcig dang dbu zhwa phya'u chos sman pur ras na bza' dang bcas pa/ paṇa chen dpal gyi rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po'i gdung rus dang phyag phreng na bza' chab ser phya'u dbu ral bub gcig /shang mtshal phyag tsha bcu phrag gdung tsha bcu phrag gcig chos sman/ rje btsun maṅga la'i mtshan can gyi dbu lo bub gcig dang na bza' chos sman dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs/ gzhan yang mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi gdung dang ring bsrel sna tshogs pa bzhugs pa ni/ 'phags pa maudgal gyi bu chen po'i gdung*/ siṅga la'i dgra bcom pa'i tshems/ ma hā paṇḍi ta wāspa ta'i phyag nas byung ba dgra bcom pa'i sku sbyar/ dgra bcom pa 'char ka'i snam sbyar/ rig 'dzin shrī singha'i dbu lo/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi dbu lo dang phyag phreng*/ padma saṃ bha wa'i sku gzan chos rgyal dri med lhun po'i gter ma/ o rgyan gyi sku chos padma gling pa'i gter ma/ o rgyan gyi sku chos sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i tshems/ slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po'i dbu lo/ lo chen bai ro tsa na'i phyag dpe dang dbu lo/ jo bo chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyi gdung nag dang dbu lo/ rgya dpe gsog sgril gyi nang dar/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi dbu lo/ po to ba rin chen dpal gyi thugs/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi dbu lo/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi dbu lo/ nye gnas sgom pa blo gros kyi gdung*/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i dbu lo/ sha ra ba chen po'i dbu lo/ bya 'chad kha ba ye shes rdo rje'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ se spyil phu pa'i na bza'/ rgyal sras thogs med kyi dbu lo dang na bza'/ mgar dam pa rgyal ba chos sding pa'i bzhugs gdan| mgar dam pa'i dbon po pha rin chen pa'i bzhugs gdan/

spyan snga thog thub pa'i na bza'/ spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa'i gdung*/ kun spangs rin chen dpal gyi dbu lo/ yongs 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dbu lo/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen gyi dbu lo dang gdung rus/ mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs kyi gdung rus/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i phya'u/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i gdung rus dang dbu zhwa/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i phyag phreng dang pur ras/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi dbu lo/ dkon mchog yan lag gi chab ser/ 'dzam gling rnam rgyal grags pa'i dbu lo dang phya'u/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dbang phyug rdo rje'i dbu lo dang gdung rus gsol ber/ thams cad mkhyen pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi dbu lo gsang chen| dpal rga lo tsā ba'i sku sha dang gdung rus/ phyag bu sgom pa tshul khrims snying po'i phya'u/ sho sgom pa'i phyag tsha/ bla ma zhang gi na bza'/ stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal gyi dbu zhwa| stag lung kun dga' bkra shis kyi dbu lo/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje'i gdung thal/ mkhas grub u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyi gdung rus/ 'ba' ra ba rin chen dpal bzang po'i phyag sgrog /mi pham padma dkar po'i sku chings/ sgam po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi phyag phreng dang gdung*/ sgam po mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug gi phyag phreng dang dbu lo na bza'| zhang ka ma ba'i na bza'/ ma hā nā tha'i zhal tshoms/ grub chen dza har pīr gyi zhal tshoms dang phyag phreng*/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i dbu lo dang tshe ril/ rtogs ldan dka' thub pa'i sgom thag dang dbu dbyings la byon pa'i thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa/ ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma'i na bza'/ mkha' 'gro ma bsod nams dpal 'dren gyi dbu lo dang dbu thod/ yum g.yang khug gi dbu lo/ lcam skal ldan gyi gdung rus/ kong smyon 'jam dpal bzang po'i gdung rus/ phyag chen 'jam dpal bzang po'i gdung rus/

kong po bde chen rol pa'i thugs/ 'bum thugs 'gyur dmar po grags pa lo tsā ba khams pa go cha'i phyag ris kyi tshal pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gaṇḍī dang sku sbyar gyi tshal pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bdud rtsi ril bu/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi sku mtshal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyi gsang chab/ zhabs drung sngags 'chang chen po'i dbu lo/ bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub kyi dbu lo/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku sha/ sems dpa' zla ba blo gros kyi dbu lo/ bcom ldan rig ral gyi gdung*| paṇḍi ta yid 'ong gi sku sha/ rgyal ba don steng pa'i na bza'/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi gdung*/ mkhas grub smon lam dpal ba'i dbu thod/ lho rin po che'i dbu lo| mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ mkhan chen nam mkha' tshul khrims kyi gdung*/ mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen gyi dbu lo/ mkhan chen byams pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbu lo dang phyag phreng*/ paṇa chen sha ra'i sgom thag /rgya gar phyag na rdo rje'i sgom thag /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i phyag phreng*/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dbu lo dang gdung rus/ lha sras mu tig btsad po'i dbu lo dang gdung rus/ mnga' bdag nyang gis lho brag smra bo lcog nas bton pa'i shog ser| nyang ral gyi sku sha/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog sangs rgyas gling pa'i thugs dang phyag phreng dbu lo na bza' sman nag shog ser dam rdzas rol ba chen po/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi na bza'/ ratna gling pa'i sku sha dang pañtsa/ 'gro 'dul las 'phro gling pa'i na bza' dang pañtsa/ chos rgyal dri med lhun po'i sku sha ril bu/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyi dbu lo/ u rgyan gling pa'i dbu lo/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi dbu lo/

zhig po gling pa'i dbu lo/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi dbu lo ngo mtshar can/ rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje'i dbu zhwa dang gsang chab/ mnga' ris paṇa chen padma dbang gi rgyal po'i shog ser dang dbu lo gdung rus/ gu ru chos dbang gi sku sha/ rje btsun pradzñā rasmi'i dbu lo| de'i gter ma bram ze padma dkar po'i sku sha dang dam rdzas rol ba chen po/ bram ze padma dkar po'i dbu thod u rgyan gling pa'i gter ma/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i dbu thod/ padma gling pa'i thugs sras tshe dbang grags pa'i dbu lo/ sras ye shes rdo rje'i sku sha ril bu/ sprul sku zla ba grags pa'i dbu lo/ grol thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi shog ser/ gu ru chos dbang gi sras padma dbang chen gyi dbu lo/ kaḥthog pa rdo rje bzang po'i gdung*/ chos bdag nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ kun skyong gling pa'i gdung rus/ thugs sras zla ba'i phya'u/ nam mkha' bsod nams kyi sku mtshal/ byang dpal ldan seṅge'i gdung rus dang dbu klad na bza' dbu lo/ chos rgyal bkra shis kyi gdung rus/ shes rab dpal gyi gdung rus/ dpal 'bar dbang phyug gi gdung rus/ dpal 'bar bkra shis kyi dbu lo/ rdzogs chen pa bsod nams rin chen gyi gdung rus/ gar dbang padma rnam rgyal gyi dbu lo dang na bza' gdung rus/ rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin gyi gdung rus/ gter gsar dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi shog ser/ thugs rje chen po'i shog ser/ tshe dpag med kyi shog ser/ skye bdun a tham ma/ u rgyan yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar 'dres ma/ bram ze dung rna can gyi sku sha/ tshe chu ril bu/ bram ze dri med snying po'i dbu thod/ byang chub ljon shing*/ bram ze dri med kyi sku sha/ dam rdzas kun 'dus/ dam rdzas myong grol/ gzhan yang tsā ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i mtsho zan dang rde'u sindhu ra dngos grub kyi rdzas la sogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/

gangs ti se'i gangs tig |mtsho ma dros pa'i bye ma sna lnga/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi jo bo'i khrus chab/ rang byung lnga ldan gyi sku 'dam/ gdan sa phag mo gru'i sku 'bum sprag gi sku 'dra'i sku 'dam/ 'jag spyil gyi gzims mal sku 'dra'i chos gos kyi gra/ sku 'bum thams cad kyi sa/ ra la'i rnam snang gi sku 'dam/ byams bdun gyi sku 'dam/ byang rwa sgreng gi ming chen shug pa brgyad kyi shing sna/ byang chub snying po'i rten ma hā bo dhi'i sku 'dam/ mchod rten rnam dag gi sa/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi sa/ gnam mtsho'i sa sna/ dur khrod brgyad kyi sa sna/ shar yel phug gi sa sna/ gzhan yang gnas ri khyad par can rnams kyi sa sna rdo sna sogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ chos kyi ring bsrel gyi tshogs bzhugs pa ni/ thog mar bla ma'i mtshan 'bum/ gdan sa chen po 'bri gung byang chub gling gi gdan rabs/ phyag chen lnga ldan gyi brgyud rim/ nā ro chos drug gi brgyud rim/ rje 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' 'bum gyi brgyud rim/ 'bri gung pa chen po'i zab chos/ dgongs pa gcig pa/ bstan pa'i snying po/ bde mchog rga lo lha lnga/ bde mchog lu hi pa/ dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba/ rngog pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu/ tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ zhi khro nges don snying po/ thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol/ bla ma dgongs 'dus| bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa/ rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud/ mkhan brgyud gsar ma/ sbyor ba yan lag drug /sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs/ dgongs pa yang zab/ gshin rje tshe bdag bka' gter gnyis/ yang zlog me'i spu gri/ drang srong loka tri pā la/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma sogs kyi brgyud rim dang*/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i brgyud pa/

mdo mang rgya gar 'gyur dang rgya nag 'gyur rnams so so dang*/ rgyas pa 'bum/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ khri brgyad stong pa/ shes rab khri pa/ brgyad stong phreng ba can/ sher phyin sna tshogs pa rnams dang*/ gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho spyi dang bye brag gi brgyud rim rnams legs par sbyar ba'i skad du bsgyur ba tshar re re/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs dang*/ bka' drin che ba'i paṇḍi ta brgya rtsa/ lo tsā ba chen po brgya rtsa/ grub chen brgyad cu'i mtshan 'bum rnams tshar gsum gsum bzhugs so// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kyi gzungs sngags bzhugs tshul ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha yongs su rdzogs pa dbang sngags dang bcas pa/ dus 'khor 'khor lo sdom chen gyi gzungs/ bde mchog lū hi pa/ nag po pa/ dril bu pa gsum gyi lha gtso 'khor ma lus pa'i sngags so so'i bzhed pa dang mthun pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dkyil 'khor drug gi sngags ma lus pa/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i sngags/ kye rdor lha dgu/ bdag med ma lha bco lnga/ gur rigs bsdus lha zhe dgu/ dgyes rdor mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun/ ma hā mā yā/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ padma dra ba/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ rdo rje phur pa/ bde mchog sdom 'byung*/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor 'khor lo chen po/ phyag rdor gtum po/ gshed dmar lha bcu gsum pa/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ rje btsun/ gshin rje dgra nag /'jigs byed/ gdong drug /bde chen ral gcig lha nyer lnga/ yang gsang 'dus/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jigs byed rnams 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sngags ring sogs rgyud dang sgrub thabs las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa re re la yang tshar dgu dgu/

rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor la rdo rje dbyings/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gtso 'khor| de'i skal bzang dang 'jig rten pa'i sngags/ rtse mo rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor dgu/ bde mchog rdor sems dpal mchog rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor brgyad/ rdo rje 'khor lo 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu/ mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud lugs/ nam mkha' dri med rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gzungs dkyil chos dkyil las kyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ ye shes sems dpa'/ rigs lnga/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor/ kun rig gi dkyil 'khor/ gtsug dgu/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ mi 'khrugs pa de dag gi gtso 'khor 'jig rten pa sogs kyi sngags yongs su rdzogs pa re re la'ang tshar bcu bcu/ spyod rgyud kyi skor la/ rnam snang mngon byang gi gtso dkyil/ rnam snang gi gzungs thugs chos 'byung*/ nam mkha'i spyan ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ grags ldan ma/ gos dkar mo/ phyag rgya yid bzhin nor bu/ phyag na rdo rje| rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gnyis/ rdo rje rtse mo/ mi g.yo ba/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal/ gdul ka /mngon phyogs/ shākya thub pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ lha mo mdzod spu| gtsug tor spyi/ gdugs dkar/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor/ rnam rgyal/ rnam par mthor ba/ gzi brjid phung po/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha lnga/ gtsug tor cher 'byung*/ gyen 'byung*/ sgra dbyangs mtha' yas/ me lha drang srong drug /gshin rje/ 'chi bdag /dus mtshan ma/ gzhon nu ma/ bden bral/ lha dbang*/ chu lha/ nyi ma/ tshangs pa| sa'i lha mo/ dbyangs can ma/ khyab 'jug /skem byed/ rlung lha/ bde byed/ zla ba/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ khro mo gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ sa bdag /dga' bo dang nyer dga'| rdo rje dam pa sbyin pa/ dra ba can/ dri med 'od/ skra can ma/ nye ba'i skra can ma/ sna tshogs ma/

nor ldan ma/ 'gug ma/ phyag brnyan ma lnga/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ ngo mtshar can| mi 'jigs sbyin/ ngan song spong*/ skyong sems blo gros/ byams pa mngon 'byung*/ blo chen/ gdung ba thams cad zhi byed/ blo gros bsam mi khyab/ sa'i snying po/ rin chen 'byung gnas/ rin chen lag /phyag na rdo rje/ bsam pa brtan pa/ nam mkha'i snying po/ nam mkha'i blo gros/ rnam dag blo gros/ spyod pa'i blo gros/ nam mkha' dri med/ brtan pa'i blo gros/ gdul ka/ mngon phyogs kyi gzungs de rnams re re la'ang tshar bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod/ bya rgyud kyi skor la/ don yod zhags pa/ spyan ras gzigs klu sgrub lugs/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo'i lugs/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge'i sgra/ sman bla'i mdo gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya rigs gnyis/ rten 'brel snying po srog shing brtan pa/ snying po yi ge drug ma/ brtan bzhugs/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ 'jam dpal gyis dam bcas pa dang dmod btsug pa dang zhal nas gsungs pa'i sngags/ 'jam dpal shes rab blo 'phel| 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sa bcu'i gzungs/ khro bo sme brtsegs kyi bstod sngags/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ phyag rdor gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgrib pa rnam sel gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sa snying gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ byams pas dam bcas pa/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ rin po che'i khang bu brtsegs pa/ nor bu brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang mthong ba don yod/ mdzod spu'i nor bu/ mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ yon sbyong*/ brgyad stong pa/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgrol ma'i gzungs/

sgrol mas dam bcas pa/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ 'jigs pa las sgrol ba/ lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ gza'i yum/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ shes rab snying po'i gzungs/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ gser 'od kyi gzungs| shākya seṅge'i gzungs/ rma bya chen mo'i gzungs/ tshe dpag med kyi gzungs/ chos thams cad kyi yum gyi gzungs/ tsandan yan lag gi gzungs/ sgrol ma mchog gi gzungs/ nam mkha' lding gi gzungs/ rnam 'joms kyi gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ brtan bzhugs/ tshe dpag med kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ rten 'brel snying po/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo'i lugs/ 'od zer can ma'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar| snying po yig drug /so sor 'brang ma'i gzungs/ stong chen rab 'joms kyi gzungs/ rma bya chen mo'i gzungs/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin gyi gzungs/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi gzungs| sangs rgyas dri med 'od kyi snying po/ dri med 'od kyi srog shing gi gzungs/ dri med 'od kyi mchod rten gyi yo byad byin rlabs/ sgrib pa rnam sel gyi gzungs/ mchod rten rab gnas kyi sngags/ mchod pa dang skor ba'i gzungs/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal rnams kyi gzungs ring*/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sogs re re la'ang tshar bcu gnyis bcu gnyis bzhugs/ nag po chen po'i snying po/ e ka dzā ti/ lha mo/ zhal bzhi pa/ yum bzhi/ gnon sngags/ gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra bha tra/ srin mo/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ lha mo/ phub ral/ beng*/ gri gug /gnod sbyin/ mgon po stag zhon/ lha mo/ mon pa gsum/ phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ rnam sras rta bdag brgyad/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu/

tshogs bdag /tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ dbang phyug /khyab 'jug /lha mo brgyad/ lha brgyad/ klu brgyad/ gza' dgu/ phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ sgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu rnams kyi gzungs ring thung rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams re re yang tshar bcu gnyis re bzhugs/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi ayai ring*/ aye thung*/ nyi ma bzhi pa/ yi ge bcu bdun pa/ yi ge bcu gcig pa/ bsrung ba'i sngags/ loka tri pā la zhi drag /bla ma dgongs 'dus/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa la sogs pa tshar gsum re/ badzra gu ru nyis brgya lhag pa/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring lnga brgya dang drug cu re gsum/ rten 'brel snying po stong phrag phyed gsum lhag pa rnams bzhugs/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pa la/ byang chub ljon shing la slob dpon klu sgrub kyi phyag brkos thub pa bdud 'dul ma/ rgya ma'i gtsug lag khang gi me thub thub pa gdan chung ma/ bdag rang gis stod lung kha rag padma shel phug nas rnyed pa'i o rgyan gyi rdo sku rang byon/ 'bri gung ras chen pa'i thugs dam gan shog sngon po la dzambu chu bo'i gser gyis bris pa'i stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa po ti bzhi/ sangs rgyas rab tu mang po'i mtshan 'bum/ drin lan bsabs mdo| gzungs grwa lnga/ gser 'od dam pa/ gnyos chen po rgyal ba lha nang pa'i phyag dpe phying khug ma'i nang tshan bcu chos dang dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa la sogs pa bzhugs pa rnams go rim ma 'khrugs shing gnas ma 'chol bar rgyud kyi dgongs pa paṇa grub tshad ldan gyi bzhed srol ji lta bar rin po che dang sman dang dri bzang gi phye mas yongs su gtams te legs par bzhugs/ de dag gi 'og tu gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa zha lu pa chen po'i bzhed pa ltar bris pa dang bskyed pa dang mnyes pa'i cho ga byas shing zhal sbyar ba dang*/

de'i 'og tu rin po che'i rigs/ sman dang*/ dri dang*/ snying po dang*/ bcud bza' btung dang*/ gri khrab/ dar zab/ 'bras bu dang*/ 'bru'i rigs rnams kyang dri bzang gis sbags shing rlung mi 'chor ba'i ca ga byas te/ 'khrul ba'i dri ma dang bral zhing*/ gong ma'i bzhed srol rnam dpyod kyi cha yongs su dag par byas te bzhugs/ de'i sa stegs chen po'i nang du dpal rga lo tsā ba'i bzhed pa ltar/ klu chen po brgyad kyi gter bum gyi mtshan nyid yongs su tshang ba bskyed cing dgug pa'i cho ga byas te 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bab pa dang*/ lo 'bras rtag tu legs pa'i ched du rnam par dag pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar te bzhugs so// de ltar legs par grub nas thog mar rang nyid kyis 'jam dpal

zla gsang nag po'i dkyil 'khor du rab tu gnas pa rgyas pa sta gon dang dngos gzhi/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg sogs rgyud kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa ltar 'bad pas bsgrubs shing*/ de'i rjes su slar yang dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du rab gnas byas pa dang*/ smon lam shis brjod dga' ston sogs bstan 'gro'i don du 'gyur ba'i theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed 'ba' zhig gis mtshams sbyar te legs par grub pa bgyis pa yin gyis/ de ltar bas na bdag gzhan gyi don tu tshogs gnyis rgya chen po myur du rdzogs pa'i dad ldan blo gros dang rnam dpyod kyi cha shas kyi bsam pa dge bas phyag lan gcig btsal kyang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen por 'gyur nges la/ phyogs lhung dang bdag gzhan grub mtha'i nga yir 'dzin pa'i snying sran can rnams la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su byon yang*/ legs skar ltar las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir byams pa'i chos kyis bsdu ba'i dngos po nyid kyi gnas su rigs par byos shig smras pa/ 'gro la rtag par brtse ba'i thugs can des// dri med mdo mang nang gsungs ji lta ba'i// rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sku'i mtshan ma 'di// bstan 'gror sman slad smon lam dag pas bsgrubs// 'di dge zla ba'i 'od ltar ches gsal ba// mtha' yas 'gro dang thun mong nyid byas nas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po myur skem ste// 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo// zhes rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten gyi dkar chag mdo tsam 'di yang*| dad ldan rnams kyi mos gus kyi dran pa gsos btab pa'i phyir/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rang lo bzhi bcu pa'i steng pho brang chen po bkra shis tshugs su mgyogs par bris so//
